brief: Finds and removes repeated characters or repeated substrings in a text.
detail: Build one with new stzStringDuplicates("banana"). DuplicatedChars, UniqueChars and their counts look at single characters, whole letters, not bytes, so Hebrew, Arabic and emoji work; comparisons are case-sensitive. The Remove verbs change the text held (RemoveConsecutiveDuplicateChars collapses runs, RemoveAllDuplicateChars keeps the first of each character, RemoveDuplicateSubString keeps the first occurrence of a substring) and each has a passive twin that returns the result. Do not pass a stzString object you still need: the first in-place edit empties it. RemoveDuplicateSubString mishandles overlapping matches.
